pairs.subject: companion-runtime
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/athena/[id]/message/route.ts:75 The message route dispatches runAthenaTurn without holding a conversation-scoped lock or supporting an interrupted turn verdict, permitting concurrent turn interleaving and treating stops as errors.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/athena/proposals/[id]/resolve/route.ts:133 The catalog is re-consulted at acceptance time via coerceAthenaAction, retiring unknown actions.
src/app/api/cron/athena/route.ts:104 The autonomous cycle acquires an atomic at-most-once claim before spending, skips on live turns, and enforces ceilings.
src/lib/athena/turn.ts:41 The turn lacks an interrupted verdict and neither runtime nor route holds a conversation lock to guard turn concurrency.
src/lib/athena/turn.ts:80 The turn runtime receives all host capabilities as an injected object and is tested against doubles without host dependencies.
src/lib/llm/leg.ts:139 Every LLM call requires an explicit, un-defaulted legKind, and token usage is parsed centrally with nullable tokens.
src/lib/athena/cycle.ts:161 Instead of an in-process operative set, in-flight work is inferred by querying durable database turn timestamps.
src/lib/athena/cycle-signal.ts:120 Every autonomous outcome passes a typed report-or-absorb judgment that produces textless absorbed outcomes and emits no contact when quiet.
